title: Up
about: Phrasal verbs with up. In housework verbs up means 'completely, until nothing is left' (clear up, tidy up, use up, eat up); in others it is part of the meaning (show up, turn up, open up, liven up), and with divide and chop it means 'into small pieces'.

parts.title: Up for completing or finishing something
What up adds
parts.note: Up часто додає ідею «повністю, до кінця»: tidy up, clear up, use up, eat up, drink up, load up, clog up, jumble up. З divide і chop (а також cut, tear, smash) up означає «на багато дрібних частин». У таких дієсловах up часто можна пропустити: речення лишиться правильним, а up лише підсилює значення. А в show up, turn up і liven up без up потрібного значення немає.

rows: use up, eat up, drink up
load up, clog up, jumble up
divide up, chop up (also cut up, tear up, smash up)
into lots of small pieces or parts
Sweep the floor. Hang it on the hook. (a different pattern)
with up you name the dirt or the clothes: sweep up the leaves, hang up your coat
show up, turn up, liven up
She turned at last. Music will liven the party. (wrong)
up is essential: without it the meaning is lost

items.pattern: clear up · clear sth up · with or without an object; separable: clear up the kitchen / clear the kitchen up / clear it up, never clear up it · objects: a room, a mess, the toys, the dishes · clear up after sb (after the children, after guests) · up = completely
items.meaning: make a place tidy and clean again, especially by taking away rubbish and putting things back where they belong
items.uk: прибрати (після когось чи чогось), навести лад
items.example: After the barbecue, everyone helped to **clear up**.
more: I'm not **clearing up** after you again. Put your own plates away!
It took us all Sunday morning to **clear up** the garage.
items.watchOut: Займенник посередині: clear it up, не clear up it. Clear up має й інші значення: погода прояснюється (it's clearing up), минає хвороба (my rash has cleared up), з'ясувати непорозуміння (clear up a misunderstanding). Прибрати зі столу — clear the table, без up.

items.pattern: sweep sth up · separable: sweep up the leaves / sweep the leaves up / sweep them up · also without an object: I'll sweep up · the object is the dirt itself (crumbs, leaves, sand, broken glass), not the place · sweep – swept – swept
items.meaning: collect dirt or rubbish from the floor or the ground with a brush
items.example: There's sand all over the hall. Could you **sweep** it **up**?
more: I broke a glass, so I **swept up** the pieces before the children came in.
After the storm, the whole street was out **sweeping up** branches and leaves.
items.watchOut: Підмести підлогу — sweep the floor, без up. Sweep up — коли додаток саме сміття: sweep up the crumbs / the broken glass. Форми: sweep – swept – swept, не sweeped.

items.pattern: tidy up · tidy sth up · with or without an object; separable: tidy up your room / tidy your room up / tidy it up · objects: a room, a desk, toys, papers, the garden · mainly British · up = completely; it can be left out: tidy your room
items.meaning: make a room or a group of things neat by putting everything in its proper place
items.example: Please **tidy up** your room before your friends come round.
more: I spent the evening **tidying up** the kitchen cupboards.
The garden looks much better since we **tidied** it **up**.
items.watchOut: «Навести порядок» — tidy up, а не make order. «Прибирати» буває різне: tidy up — розкласти речі по місцях; clean — мити, витирати пил; put sth away — прибрати річ на її місце (put your toys away). Займенник посередині: tidy it up.

items.pattern: be / lie (all) jumbled up · adjective from the verb jumble sth up · things are jumbled up in a drawer, in a box, in a pile, on the floor · also words or thoughts · up can be left out: jumbled
items.meaning: mixed together in an untidy way, with no order
items.example: My old letters and photos are all **jumbled up** in a shoebox.
more: My keys were **jumbled up** with old receipts at the bottom of my bag.
When I'm nervous, my words come out all **jumbled up**.
items.watchOut: Jumbled up — про речі, звалені безладно, або про слова й думки. Про людину, яка заплуталася, кажуть confused, не jumbled up. Вимова: jumble /ˈdʒʌmbl/, голосний як у but.

items.pattern: hang sth up (on sth) · separable: hang up your coat / hang your coat up / hang it up · objects: clothes, a coat, a towel, a dressing gown · on a hook, on a peg, in the wardrobe · hang – hung – hung
items.meaning: put clothes or a towel on a hook or a hanger
items.example: **Hang** your wet jacket **up** by the radiator so it can dry.
more: The hotel asks guests to **hang up** the towels they want to use again.
Come in and **hang up** your coat. Tea's nearly ready.
items.watchOut: Форми: hang – hung – hung; hanged — тільки «стратили через повішення». Без додатка hang up — покласти слухавку: She hung up on me. Займенник посередині: hang it up.

items.pattern: load sth up (with sth) · separable: load up the car / load the car up / load it up · also without an object: load up with sth · objects: a car, a van, a trolley, the dishwasher, the washing machine · up = completely full; it can be left out
items.meaning: put a lot of things into a vehicle or a machine
items.example: We **loaded up** the car the night before, so we could leave at five.
more: Can you **load up** the washing machine while I make the beds?
Shoppers were **loading up** their trolleys with bottled water before the storm.
items.watchOut: Чим завантажити — with: load the car up with bags. Або навпаки: load the bags into the car. Не «load the car by bags».

items.pattern: be / get clogged up (with sth) · from the verb clog (sth) up: hair clogs up the pipe · subjects: a sink, a drain, a pipe, a washbasin, roads (with traffic), your nose · up can be left out: clogged
items.meaning: blocked, so that water, air or traffic can't get through
items.example: The kitchen sink is **clogged up** again. Has someone been pouring oil down it?
more: The town centre gets **clogged up** with tourists every summer.
I've got a cold, and my nose is completely **clogged up**.
items.watchOut: Чим забитий — with: clogged up with hair / leaves / traffic, не by. Британці частіше кажуть blocked, але clogged (up) теж звичне слово.

items.pattern: use sth up · separable: use up the milk / use the milk up / use it up · objects: food, milk, money, energy, time, paper · often with all: used up all the hot water · up = all of it, nothing left
items.meaning: use all of a supply so that there is none left
items.example: Who's **used up** all the shampoo? The bottle's empty.
more: Let's **use up** the old bread and make a bread pudding.
By lunchtime I'd **used up** all my energy and needed a rest.
items.watchOut: Use up — використати все (хтось це зробив). Закінчитися — run out (of): We've run out of milk ≈ Someone has used up all the milk. Займенник посередині: use it up, не use up it.

items.pattern: eat up · eat sth up · with or without an object; separable: eat up your vegetables / eat them up · often what parents say to children: Eat up! · up = every bit of it; it can be left out
items.meaning: eat all the food you have been given
items.example: **Eat up** your soup, or it'll get cold.
more: The kids **ate up** every bit of the pizza in ten minutes.
Come on, **eat up**! We're leaving in five minutes.
items.watchOut: Eat up! — «Доїдай!». Не плутай з eat out — поїсти не вдома, у кафе чи ресторані.

items.pattern: drink up · drink sth up · with or without an object; separable: drink up your juice / drink it up · Drink up! = finish your drink (often because it's time to go) · up = all of it
items.meaning: drink all of a drink, often quickly
items.example: **Drink up** your tea. The train leaves in ten minutes.
more: The barman called out, 'Time to **drink up**, please!'
She **drank up** her medicine and pulled a face.
items.watchOut: Drink up! — «Допивай(те)!». Випити за когось чи щось — drink to sb/sth, не drink up: Let's drink to Anna!

items.pattern: show up · intransitive · show up at / for sth: at a party, for work, for a meeting · often late, at last or not at all · informal; very close to turn up
items.meaning: arrive at a place where people are expecting you, often late or after a delay
items.example: The electrician said he'd come at ten, but he didn't **show up** until two.
more: Half the class didn't **show up** on the last day before the holidays.
She finally **showed up** at the party with a huge cake.
items.watchOut: «З'явитися» — show up, не appear up. Show off — хизуватися; show sb up — осоромити когось: Don't show me up in front of my friends!

items.pattern: turn up · intransitive · turn up at / for sth · often unexpectedly or late: turn up late, turn up out of the blue · informal; very close to show up
items.meaning: arrive somewhere, often without warning or later than expected
items.example: My cousin **turned up** at our door with two suitcases and no warning.
more: Dozens of people **turned up** to help clean the beach.
If you **turn up** late for the exam, they won't let you in.
items.watchOut: Turn sth up — зробити гучніше або сильніше: turn the music / the heating up. А turn up без додатка — з'явитися, прийти. Ще turn up — знайтися (про загублену річ): My ring turned up under the sofa.

items.pattern: sb opens sth up · sth opens up · with or without an object; separable: open up a café / open it up · subjects or objects: a shop, a café, a restaurant, a hotel, a business · up can be left out: they've opened a café
items.meaning: start a new shop or business, or (of a shop or business) start for the first time
items.example: My neighbour has **opened up** a little flower shop near the station.
more: When the factory closed, he used his savings to **open up** a garage.
They sold their house to **open up** a bed and breakfast by the sea.
items.watchOut: Open up про людину — відкритися, розповісти про почуття: He finally opened up to me. Відчинити двері — open the door, без up; Open up! — «Відчиняйте!» (так кажуть, коли грюкають у двері).

items.pattern: liven sth up · separable: liven up the party / liven the party up / liven it up · also without an object: things livened up after ten · objects: a party, an evening, a room, a town, a dish
items.meaning: make something more interesting, exciting or lively
items.example: A few plants would **liven up** this grey office.
more: Let's put some music on to **liven** things **up**.
A little lemon and garlic will **liven up** the sauce.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈlaɪvn/, як прикметник live («живий»), а не дієслово live. «Оживити вечірку» — liven up the party, не make the party alive і не live up the party (live up to — виправдати очікування).

items.pattern: a set-up (noun) · from the verb set sth up (arrange, organise, start) · What's the set-up? · the set-up at work, at home, in a flat, in a business · also written setup
items.meaning: the way something is organised or arranged
items.uk: устрій, організація справ; як усе влаштовано
items.example: I've just joined the team, so I'm still getting used to the **set-up**.
more: What's the **set-up** at your new school? Do you have the same teacher for everything?
It's a family business, and the **set-up** is simple: Dad cooks and Mum does the money.
items.watchOut: Іменник пишуть через дефіс або разом (a set-up / a setup), наголос на першому складі: SET-up. Дієслово — окремо, наголос на up: set UP a business. У розмовній мові a set-up — ще й «підстава».

items.pattern: divide sth up (into / between / among sth) · separable: divide up the work / divide the work up / divide it up · into groups, parts, teams; between two people, among several · objects: work, money, profits, a cake, a class · up = into parts; it can be left out
items.meaning: separate something into smaller parts, or share it between people
items.example: We **divided up** the bill so that everyone paid for what they ate.
more: The teacher **divided** the class **up** into groups of four.
After Grandma died, her jewellery was **divided up** among her granddaughters.
items.watchOut: Ділити НА частини — divide into, не on: divide the cake up into eight pieces. Між двома — between, між кількома — among. Займенник посередині: divide it up.

items.pattern: chop sth up (into sth) · separable: chop up an onion / chop the onion up / chop it up · objects: vegetables, onions, meat, herbs, wood · into small pieces · up = into lots of small pieces; it can be left out · the same up: cut up, tear up, smash up
items.meaning: cut something, especially food, into small pieces
items.example: **Chop up** the tomatoes and add them to the pan.
more: We **chopped up** an old wooden chair for the campfire.
I **chopped** the apple **up** so the baby could eat it.
items.watchOut: Нарізати НА шматки — chop into pieces (into, не on). Chop down — зрубати дерево, а не нарізати. Тонкими скибками — slice, натерти на тертці — grate.

warmup.uk: Наведи порядок у своїй кімнаті, поки не прийшла бабуся!
warmup.q: ___ your room before Granny gets here!
warmup.explain: Навести порядок — tidy up (your room). Make order — калька, так не кажуть.

warmup.q: I ___ my coat in the wardrobe.
warmup.explain: Hang – hung – hung. Hanged — тільки про страту. Hang on — зачекати або триматися.

warmup.q: The washbasin is clogged up ___ hair.
warmup.explain: Чим забитий — with: clogged up with hair, with leaves, with traffic.

warmup.q: Someone has ___ all the hot water.
warmup.explain: Use up — використати все, до кінця. Out тут не підходить.
Прийти, з'явитися — show up (або turn up). Show off — хизуватися.
Пожвавити — liven up /ˈlaɪvn/. Live up to — виправдати очікування; make alive — калька.

warmup.q: Let's divide up the money ___ three parts.
warmup.explain: Ділити на частини — divide (up) into. On — калька з української.
Нарізати — chop (up) into pieces. Chop down — зрубати дерево.

A.q: There's broken glass on the kitchen floor. Get the brush and ___ it up.
A.explain: Sweep up — змести щіткою (скло, крихти, листя). Hang up — повісити; load up — завантажити.

A.q: We'd ___ up all the hot water, so I had to have a cold shower.
A.explain: Use up — використати весь запас. Eat up і drink up — про їжу й напої.

A.q: The kitchen sink is ___ up with tea leaves, and the water won't go down.
A.explain: Clogged up — забитий. Jumbled up — перемішаний абияк; loaded up — завантажений.

B.q: My brother said he'd come at six, but he didn't ___ up until nine.
B.explain: Show up (або turn up) — прийти, з'явитися. Open up — відкрити(ся); liven up — пожвавити.

B.q: Our village is so quiet. A new café would really ___ it up.
B.explain: Liven sth up — пожвавити. Turn sth up — зробити гучніше; divide sth up — поділити.

B.q: I don't understand the ___ here. Who's in charge of what?
B.explain: A set-up — як усе влаштовано. A build-up — наростання, накопичення; a break-up — розрив (стосунків).

example.title: A party in a hurry
example.uk:
У п'ятницю ввечері мій брат Том з'явився з двома пакетами продуктів і сказав: «Влаштуймо завтра вечірку!» Тож у суботу зранку ми розподілили обов'язки. Я прибрав у вітальні й повісив пальта, які лежали на кожному стільці. Том дрібно нарізав овочі для величезної каструлі супу й витратив усю цибулю в домі.

Потім засмітилася кухонна раковина, і я цілу годину прибирав цей безлад, поки Том дзвонив сантехніку.

О сьомій прийшли наші друзі, і музика Тома швидко пожвавила вечір. До півночі всі доїли суп, а в домі знову був безлад.
example.en:
On Friday evening my brother Tom [[turned up|b2]] with two bags of shopping and said, 'Let's have a party tomorrow!' So on Saturday morning we [[divided up|b6]] the jobs. I [[tidied up|a3]] the living room and [[hung up|a5]] the coats that were lying on every chair. Tom [[chopped up|b7]] vegetables for a huge pot of soup and [[used up|a8]] every onion in the house.

Then the kitchen sink got [[clogged up|a7]], and I spent an hour [[clearing up|a1]] the mess while Tom phoned a plumber.

At seven our friends [[showed up|b1]], and Tom's music soon [[livened up|b4]] the evening. By midnight everyone had [[eaten up|a9]] the soup, and the house was a mess again.
